development: anchor_offer0_outcome_known; 603 respondents and 381 nonrespondents; seven unknown no-offer excluded; 609 offered excluded
evaluation: all 3592 cohort2 invitees, continuing and new colleges reported separately
evidence_ceiling: fictional arithmetic under administrative observation policy; no causal or missing-at-random claim
fallback: survey_fallback uses its survey logistic only with both scores available; otherwise frozen frame_only model

imputation.fit_rows: known-outcome no-offer development rows with that scale observed
imputation.method: two deterministic unpenalized OLS QR regressions, one per scale, using frame only
imputation.uncertainty_claim: not multiple imputation; no completed-data uncertainty guarantee

indicator_alias_policy: score-unavailable indicators equal nonresponse in the frozen data and are not additional regressors; future unscorable responder patterns flagged unsupported

item_rule.score: mean of observed reversed items; no outcome in scoring

learner.failure: rank, conditioning, nonfinite, separation or nonconvergence stops; no silent coefficient deletion
learner.objective: summed negative natural-log Bernoulli likelihood plus 0.5 times sum of squared slopes
learner.penalty_selection: fixed numerical stabilizer after development-only separation diagnostic, before any Unit11 evaluation metrics; no tuning

legacy_evaluation: includes 1341 previous continuing_final and 655 previous new_updating plus 654 previous new_final respondents, with 942 newly available nonrespondents; not newly untouched data
new_student: manual fictional records; JSON or CSV frame and optional observed items only; no outcome, future variables or reference to existing student lookup
observation_policy: Tonmick derived observed v1.1.0; unknown consent outcomes remain blank

scores.auc: twice strict positive-negative wins plus exact ties divided by twice class product
scores.binary_y: withdrawal_label; known flag required; never impute label
scores.brier: mean squared probability error on identical known-label rows
scores.prediction_coverage: all eligible later invitees; label coverage and model route reported separately

snapshot_assumption: administrative frame, baseline response status and returned baseline items resolved at enrollment; earlier forecasts require a different availability contract

standardization.fit_separately_for: each imputer, frame model, survey model, and each completed-data prediction model

target: withdrawal by month12 before transfer under no mentoring offer
